overloads.semanticRole: Creates a new (non-existent) data file on disk and hot-swaps it in as the data file used by the running 4D application, replacing the currently open one.

constraints: Fails/does nothing if a file already exists at accessPath (the command checks the path does not already correspond to an existing file before proceeding).
On 4D Server (since v13), executing this command internally calls QUIT 4D on the server first, which prompts every remote client with a server-quitting dialog.
